description: One enquiry form for product quotes, samples, OEM/ODM and partnership. Pick the enquiry type and the fields that matter for it appear.
lead: One form for every commercial route. Pick what you need and the fields that matter for it appear.

form.disclaimer: Your enquiry is prepared in this browser. The next step opens your email application addressed to Hauslysmart, where you can review and send it.
form.empty_message: Fill in the required fields and this summary fills in as well.
form.ready_message: Your enquiry is prepared below. Open your email application, review it and send it when ready.

blocks.heading: What you need from us
blocks.note: The fields below change with the enquiry type, so you only answer what is relevant.

fields.name: enquiry_type
fields.label: Enquiry type
fields.help: Technical questions fit the support route better — this form is for commercial enquiries.

fields.name: oem_scope
fields.label: What has to be customised
fields.help: Panel, colour, protocol, logo, packaging, firmware — as much or as little as is decided so far.

fields.name: sample_purpose
fields.label: What the samples are for
fields.help: Evaluation, showroom, certification testing — it changes what we prepare.

fields.name: market
fields.label: Market and channel
fields.help: Which country or region you sell in, and whether you retail, distribute or install.

blocks.heading: What you are asking about
blocks.note: For a single product enquiry, enter one model here. When you arrive from Quote List, the selected product lines and configurations appear in a review above and are carried into the message.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.help: The model code on the product page or datasheet.

fields.name: variant
fields.label: Variant / configuration
fields.help: Protocol, colour and gang, if you already know which one.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.help: A target or a range is fine. Reference prices are quoted against a quantity basis.

fields.name: target_date
fields.label: Target date
fields.help: When the order has to land. Leave it open if it is not decided yet.

fields.name: destination
fields.label: Destination port or city
fields.help: Only needed for a freight quote.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.help: Anything that decides the answer: standards, certification, wiring, packaging, or the models you listed above.

blocks.heading: What is stored and what happens next
paragraphs: Nothing you type here is uploaded to this website. The enquiry is prepared in your browser and then handed to your own email application for you to review and send.
The email is addressed to the Hauslysmart sales team. You remain in control of the final send action and keep a copy in your own Sent folder.

blocks.heading: Not the right form?
blocks.note: A technical question does not need a quantity, and a support request should not wait behind a sales queue.

items.label: Technical support
items.note: Wiring, pairing, firmware and document questions.

items.label: Contact
items.note: Every route in one place, including how to reach us directly.

items.label: Product finder
items.note: Narrow the range by real attributes before asking.
